messages:
Maya: quick thread 1: customers want a machine-readable reservation manifest + optional webhook to push to IPAM. Proposal: manifest + detached sig + webhook callback URL. Dry-run mode to validate firewall owners. Thoughts?

Dave: fine with schema. Make webhook optional and require HMAC verification. Add --dry-run to installer to emit manifest without committing.

Linh: field ask : some netops teams need TTL and reuse hints (e.g., keep IP stable for 7d). Include "reuse_window" and "sticky" flags in manifest. Also support human-readable reason field.

security: manifesto: signatures must be verifiable and artifacts envelope-encrypted if exported. Webhook delivery must use mTLS or signed payloads. Audit event for manifest generation required.

ops-bot: scheduled manifest-verify job=9901 profile=vpc-reserved :gear:

Dave: action items: - manifest schema + examples (owner: dave) - installer --dry-run + webhook support (owner: eng) - HMAC/mTLS delivery (owner: security). ETA: 3w for v1 dry-run and schema.

Maya: great. I'll draft a short runbook for field teams showing: 1) generate manifest --dry-run, 2) share with firewall owner, 3) sign+export, 4) cutover window. Follow-up sync tomorrow. Closing.
